tools.name: run
tools.title: Run a build step
tools.description: Run a shell command inside the agent's working copy, such as a build or a test. It touches only the working directory.

tools.name: read_file
tools.title: Read a file
tools.description: Read a file by its path, for example /data/orders.csv.

tools.name: write_file
tools.title: Write a file
tools.description: Write text to a file by its path, for example /work/report.txt.

tools.name: fetch
tools.title: Fetch a URL
tools.description: Send a request to a host over the network, for example api.larkspur.co. The host that receives it reads the body.

host.description: The host to reach, for example api.larkspur.co.
